title: Fix Auth Race Condition after Magic Link verification
description: Magic link verification succeeds on the client, but immediate subsequent Convex mutations (ensureAppUser, initializeDefaultGoals) fail with 'Authentication required'. This leaves the system in a 'Split-Brain' state: the user exists in the Better Auth 'user' table but is missing from the application 'users' table. The flow must be made resilient so that the app user is ALWAYS created.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Add retry logic or a small delay in verify.tsx before calling ensureAppUser
Implement idempotent check in Dashboard: if session exists but app user is missing, trigger ensureAppUser
Ensure dashboard-triggered mutations (like initializeDefaultGoals) handle 'Authentication required' gracefully or wait for session stability
Verify: Full signup flow (magic link -> dashboard) no longer shows 'Authentication required' or 'Try Again' error
Browser test: Sign up with yosef.from.the.levant@proton.me, verify app users record is created with email
Verify: User correctly exists in BOTH 'user' and 'users' tables after signup
